1st_edition.description: 1st Edition stamp — small black oval/circle with '1' and 'EDITION' text

position.notes: Wide search region to handle alignment/rotation variance

tight_position.notes: Tighter region centered on expected stamp location for second-pass OCR

1st_edition.visual: Small black circle (~30-40px at binder resolution) containing '1' with 'EDITION' text below. Sits just below the left edge of the artwork frame, to the left of the HP text. On a standard 2.5x3.5 inch card, the stamp center is approximately 8% from left edge, 59% from top.

detection_details.secondary: Dark circular blob detection via contour analysis (circularity >= 0.65)
detection_details.tertiary: HoughCircles on tight region for small dark circles
detection_details.confidence_logic: OCR match = 0.95, blob+hough = 0.90, blob only = 0.85, hough only = 0.80

shadowless.description: Shadowless variant — no drop shadow on right and bottom card border

position.notes: Right edge strip — check for absence of dark gradient shadow

alt_position.notes: Bottom edge strip — also lacks shadow on shadowless cards

shadowless.visual: No dark gradient/shadow on right and bottom borders. Unlimited cards have a visible dark shadow cast to the right and below the card frame. Shadowless cards have clean, evenly-colored borders.

detection_details.method: Compare mean brightness of rightmost 3% of card vs next 3% inward. Shadow cards show a >15 pixel value drop in the outer strip.

ex_set_stamp.description: EX-era set logo stamp on reverse holo artwork

position.notes: Bottom-right quadrant of artwork area. Wider search to handle stamp position variance.

ex_set_stamp.visual: Semi-transparent set logo and name text overlaid on the card artwork in the bottom-right area. Text appears in small caps (e.g., 'DELTA SPECIES', 'POWER KEEPERS'). Gold or silver foil with slight transparency.

detection_details.primary: PaddleOCR on artwork bottom-right region for known set name text fragments
detection_details.fallback: Set-agnostic word matching against all known stamp words

prerelease.description: PRERELEASE event stamp overlaid on card artwork

position.notes: Bottom-right area of artwork, similar position to EX set stamps. Consistent across all eras.

alt_position.notes: Some prerelease stamps appear on the left side of the artwork (less common)

prerelease.visual: Yellow/gold 'PRERELEASE' text stamp overlaid on card artwork. Modern prerelease cards (SWSH+) use a smaller, more subtle stamp. Older prerelease cards (WotC/EX era) have a larger, more prominent text stamp.

detection_details.notes: OCR often garbles this to 'PRENELEMEE' or similar. Use fuzzy matching with threshold 0.70.

black_star_promo.description: WotC-era black star promo symbol replacing set symbol

position.notes: Bottom center of card where set symbol normally appears. The black star replaces the normal set symbol.

black_star_promo.visual: Five-pointed black star with 'PROMO' text beneath it in small caps. Replaces the normal set symbol position. Star is solid black, approximately 3-5% of card width.

detection_details.method: Template matching or dark star-shaped contour detection in set symbol region

modern_promo_stamp.description: Modern promo indicator (SWSH/SV era) — typically a stylized text or symbol

position.notes: Set symbol area at bottom center. Modern promos have a promo set symbol instead of a booster set symbol.

modern_promo_stamp.visual: Modern promo cards use a stylized 'SWSH' or 'SVP' set symbol in the standard set symbol position. Some have additional promo text or stamps on the card.

detection_details.method: Classify the set symbol region to distinguish promo symbols from booster set symbols

cosmos_holo_stamp.description: Cosmos/galaxy holofoil pattern stamp on modern cards (SV era rares)

position.notes: Covers the entire artwork area. Cosmos holo is a full-artwork effect, not a localized stamp.

cosmos_holo_stamp.visual: Galaxy/cosmos pattern of small sparkle dots across the entire artwork area. Distinct from traditional parallel-line holographic pattern.

detection_details.method: HSV hue spread analysis in artwork region. Cosmos holo shows scattered high-saturation sparkle points rather than continuous holo lines.

staff_stamp.description: STAFF stamp on prerelease/event cards given to tournament staff

position.notes: Appears above or overlapping the prerelease stamp area, in the right portion of the artwork.

staff_stamp.visual: Gold 'STAFF' text, usually above or near the PRERELEASE stamp. Much rarer and more valuable than standard prerelease cards.

detection_details.primary: PaddleOCR looking for 'STAFF' text in the upper-right artwork region
detection_details.notes: Often paired with a PRERELEASE stamp. Check for both.

position.notes: Bottom-right of artwork, similar to EX set stamp position

league_stamp.visual: Various league stamps — Pokemon League logo or season-specific stamp. Usually gold or silver foil.

detection_details.method: Template matching against known league stamp designs

wotc_base.notes: 1st Edition and shadowless are the primary variant stamps. Shadowless only applies to base1.

ex_era.notes: EX set stamps only on ex7-ex16 reverse holos. Earlier EX sets (ex1-ex6) had no stamp.

dp_era.notes: No set-specific stamps on reverse holos. Prerelease cards exist.

hgss_era.notes: Minimal stamping. Prerelease cards exist for some sets.

bw_era.notes: Prerelease cards exist. No set logo stamps on reverse holos.

xy_era.notes: Prerelease cards exist. Some stamped promos for league/event distribution.

sm_era.notes: Prerelease build-and-battle promos with PRERELEASE stamp.

swsh_era.notes: Prerelease build-and-battle promos. Promo cards have SVP-style set symbol.

sv_era.notes: Prerelease build-and-battle promos. Cosmos holo on all rares. Promo cards have SVP set symbol.

position_reference.coordinate_system: All positions are normalized [0.0, 1.0] fractions of card dimensions. Origin (0,0) is top-left corner. x increases rightward, y increases downward.

stamp_landmark_notes.1st_edition: The 1st Edition stamp sits to the LEFT of the info bar, between the artwork bottom edge and the first attack. On a 2.5x3.5 inch card, the stamp center is at roughly (8%, 59%). The stamp itself is about 2-3% of card width in diameter.
stamp_landmark_notes.ex_set_stamp: The EX set logo appears in the BOTTOM-RIGHT of the artwork window, typically overlapping the artwork-to-info-bar boundary. Center at roughly (70%, 45%).
stamp_landmark_notes.prerelease: PRERELEASE text appears in the BOTTOM-RIGHT of the artwork area, often overlapping or just inside the artwork frame. Similar position to the EX set stamp.
stamp_landmark_notes.set_symbol: Set symbols appear at the BOTTOM-RIGHT of the card, to the right of the card number, at roughly (55%, 93%).
